content: Ananya Nair contacted Vikram Patel to inquire about reinstating her old insurance policy (DC-001234) instead of purchasing a new one. Vikram informed her that reinstatement takes 24-48 hours and involves a $50 lapse penalty. Ananya provided her policy number and requested coverage to resume immediately, prompting Vikram to check details with the underwriting team.

action_items: Confirm policy details with the underwriting team
Process policy reinstatement for policy DC-001234
